name: Riddle MCP
description:
Riddle gives Claude the same reach over your interactive content that you have in the Riddle Creator web app: building, editing, publishing, organising, branding and analytics. The whole cycle happens in one conversation instead of across a dozen browser tabs.
Start from a brief and Claude builds the piece, whether that's a quiz, poll, personality test, form, predictor, leaderboard, minigame or story. It gets assembled block by block, styled with your brand palette, then published with the embed code ready for your site. From there it doesn't stop at "created". Claude can read back any existing Riddle in full, change the parts that need changing (questions, answers, results, scoring, copy, design), validate it, and republish. Then pull the engagement numbers: overview stats plus breakdowns by project or by individual Riddle.
That closes the loop. Analyse what a live Riddle is doing, find the question people drop off at, rewrite it, republish, and check the numbers again next week. Each step is a tool call, so Claude can run the whole cycle across your content library and tell you what it changed and why. Question banks, templates, projects and tags are all reachable too, so an improvement made once gets reused across everything you publish.
The connection is scoped by OAuth to the account that authorises it, and respects that account's project roles and permissions.

Notes on advertising and external content
Riddle is not an advertising product and the connector serves no ads or sponsored content of its own. Worth naming up front, because it looks like the prohibited category at a glance: Riddle has an Ad block, available in all Riddle types, which the connector can place when a user asks for it. It carries no advertising from Riddle or any network. It references an ad slot the customer configured in their own project, or an iframe URL they supply, in content they own and publish themselves.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Riddle MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Riddle MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.riddle.com/creator/api/v3/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Riddle MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Riddle MCP lists 38 MCP tools, including media_delete, media_upload_link, palette_customize, palette_get, ping, project_get, project_get_settings, project_list, question_bank_create, question_bank_delete, question_bank_discard_changes, and question_bank_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Riddle MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Riddle MCP in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.

_published_faq.name: Does Riddle MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Riddle MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Riddle MCP is developed by Riddle. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
